_comment: Pipeline calibration — updated manually after reviewing PR results.

business_impact_zones._comment: Files in these zones get severity escalation. P1→P0, P2→P1. This aligns pipeline decisions with actual business risk.

critical._comment: P1 escalates to P0, P2 escalates to P1
critical.reason: Auth, security, data schema — breach or corruption risk

high._comment: P2 escalates to P1 (no P1→P0 escalation)
high.reason: Lead routing, bookings, provider profiles — direct revenue impact

standard._comment: No escalation. Default for all other paths.

known_false_positives._comment: Regex patterns. Findings matching these are suppressed before scoring.

critical_paths._comment: Files that force risk_level=high in the router.

historical_metrics._comment: Fill after each PR review. This is the data that makes the pipeline self-correcting.
historical_metrics._fields: pr, date, raw_findings, deduped, true_positives, false_positives, missed_in_prod, human_action (merged/fixed/dismissed)
